name: Porter's Five Forces
id_mapping: ENGINEERING_ADAPTATION: FW numeric correspondence to AG; source explicitly illustrates FW-11

source_original.purpose: Evaluasi daya tarik struktural industri dan tekanan margin dari 5 kekuatan kompetitif
source_original.inputs: Struktur pasar, jumlah pemasok/pembeli, hambatan masuk, produk substitusi
source_original.outputs: Skor intensitas 5 kekuatan (1–10) dan strategi pertahanan margin

activation_conditions: User requests Porter's Five Forces or the orchestrator justifies it against the problem.
methodology: Assess rivalry, entry threat, substitutes, supplier power and buyer power separately
Ground intensity judgments in evidence and define any numeric rubric
Explain how structural forces affect margins and defensive choices
tool_requirements: Host reasoning and resource reading; calculation tool when required.
evidence_requirements: Cite material claims; mark missing inputs UNKNOWN; do not reuse illustrative source conclusions.
limitations: Host-authored analysis requires behavioral evaluation; schema validity does not prove truth.
validation_criteria: Provide forces or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide margin_implications or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide options or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Use all distinctive methodology steps and identify missing evidence.
